description: Whether an artist's works are public domain and on hand to print, from the Art Institute of Chicago and Cleveland Museum of Art open-access collections: works found, how many print a full page sharp, line works, life dates, and whether there are enough for an issue (8 full-page works), with three sample works and their credit lines. Example questions: can I use Hokusai in my magazine; is Aubrey Beardsley public domain; does Gustave Doré have enough prints for an issue.
name: is_this_artist_public_domain
title: Is this artist public domain
